title: NEXT F Commerce Core Contract Registry
description: Generated index of authoritative Phase 11 Commerce Core schemas.

categories.label: Foundation
categories.description: Store settings and small reusable monetary/quantity/channel contracts used across commerce.

categories.label: Catalog
categories.description: Products, variants, options, attributes, categories, collections, pricing and availability.

categories.label: Inventory
categories.description: Inventory identities, balances, reservations, adjustments, locations and transfers.

categories.label: Customers
categories.description: Commerce buyers, addresses, snapshots, tags and operational notes.

categories.label: Cart & Checkout
categories.description: Mutable carts, checkout snapshots, contacts, addresses, shipping/payment selections and totals.

categories.label: Orders
categories.description: Immutable order snapshots, line items, totals, source and lifecycle dimensions.

categories.label: Payments & Refunds
categories.description: Provider-neutral payment references, attempts, authorizations, captures and refunds.

categories.label: Shipping & Fulfillment
categories.description: Shipping zones/rates/methods, estimates, fulfillments, shipments, packages and tracking.

categories.label: Discounts & Promotions
categories.description: Discount rules, codes, conditions, benefits and transaction allocations.

categories.label: Tax
categories.description: Provider-neutral tax configuration, tax classes, rates and transaction tax lines.

categories.label: Returns & Reviews
categories.description: Return requests/resolutions and moderated truthful product reviews.

schemas.name: Cart
schemas.purpose: Provides stable Cart state without treating it as a completed financial transaction.

validationRules.description: A Cart identifies a customer or opaque session context.
Converted transaction snapshots are not silently mutated.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Cart Line
schemas.purpose: Captures selected merchandise, quantity and calculated price without mutating catalog state.

fields.description: Discount allocations applied to this line.

validationRules.description: Cart-line quantity must be greater than zero.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Cart Totals
schemas.purpose: Standardizes Cart totals while keeping them separate from final Order totals.

validationRules.description: All totals share one currency.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Checkout
schemas.description: Checkout workflow that prepares an Order.
schemas.purpose: Creates a stable transition between mutable Cart and committed Order state.

validationRules.description: Checkout never stores raw card PAN/CVV.
Shipping data is required only for shippable lines.
A completed Checkout must resolve to one Order in the implementation/API flow.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Checkout Address Snapshot
schemas.purpose: Prevents saved-address edits from silently changing a committed Checkout.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Checkout Contact
schemas.purpose: Provides a minimal provider-neutral Checkout identity structure.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Checkout Line
schemas.purpose: Freezes the calculated Checkout line before Order creation.

fields.description: Discount allocations applied to this line.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Checkout Payment Selection
schemas.purpose: Identifies the chosen payment route without storing raw card credentials.

validationRules.description: PAN, CVV and equivalent raw card secrets are prohibited.
Provider method references must be opaque/tokenized values.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Checkout Shipping Selection
schemas.purpose: Keeps selected shipping service/price stable even if merchant rates later change.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Collection Rule
schemas.purpose: Allows deterministic collection membership without arbitrary executable expressions.

validationRules.description: Only approved rule fields may be evaluated.
Operator must match field/value type.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Commerce Customer
schemas.purpose: Separates ecommerce buyers from the NEXT F tenant Organization and Organization Users.

validationRules.description: Commerce Customer must never represent the NEXT F business tenant Organization.
Commerce Customer identity is Site scoped unless a future shared-account contract explicitly says otherwise.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Customer Address
schemas.purpose: Reuses shared address semantics with commerce-specific purpose.

fields.description: Whether this is default for its purpose.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Commerce Customer Note
schemas.description: Internal note attached to a Commerce Customer.
schemas.purpose: Provides auditable operational notes without modifying customer identity fields.

validationRules.description: Customer notes are never public storefront data.
Notes must not be used to store credentials or payment card data.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Customer Snapshot
schemas.purpose: Preserves transaction history when profile data later changes.

validationRules.description: Committed snapshots do not follow later Customer profile edits.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Commerce Customer Tag
schemas.description: Reusable operational tag for Commerce Customers.
schemas.purpose: Supports segmentation without conflating tags with permissions, consent or authoritative customer status.

validationRules.description: Customer tags must never grant platform permissions.
Customer tags must never be treated as marketing consent.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Delivery Estimate
schemas.purpose: Keeps promised/estimated delivery information structured and distinct from actual tracking facts.

validationRules.description: Minimum cannot exceed maximum and estimatedFrom cannot exceed estimatedTo.
An estimate is not converted into an actual deliveredAt fact.

delivery.notes: Only explicitly public storefront fields may be delivered; operational, personal, payment and internal metadata remain private.

schemas.name: Discount
schemas.purpose: Provides reusable promotion economics used by discount codes or automatic application.

validationRules.description: endsAt must be after startsAt.
Conditions/benefits cannot contain executable code.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Discount Allocation
schemas.purpose: Preserves exactly how a discount affected a cart, checkout or order line without depending on later promotion edits.

fields.description: Display label preserved at transaction time.

validationRules.description: Allocated discount amount cannot be negative.
Order-linked allocations are immutable transaction snapshots.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Discount Code
schemas.description: Redeemable code that activates a Discount.
schemas.purpose: Separates discount economics from customer-entered codes.

validationRules.description: Active code is unique within Site under matching policy.
usageCount is derived from committed redemptions.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Fulfillment
schemas.purpose: Keeps fulfillment execution separate from Payment state and physical Shipment tracking.

validationRules.description: Cumulative fulfillment cannot exceed eligible Order Line quantity without correction workflow.
Fulfillment state is separate from Payment state.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Fulfillment Line
schemas.description: Quantity of one Order Line in a Fulfillment.
schemas.purpose: Supports partial fulfillment without rewriting Order Line quantity.

validationRules.description: Fulfilled quantity is greater than zero.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Inventory Adjustment
schemas.purpose: Creates an auditable inventory ledger instead of unexplained stock mutation.

validationRules.description: Recorded adjustments are immutable; corrections use a new adjustment.
Adjustment delta cannot be zero.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Inventory Item
schemas.description: Inventory policy record for a purchasable Variant.
schemas.purpose: Separates inventory control from Product editorial data.

fields.description: Whether selling beyond available stock is allowed.

validationRules.description: At most one active Inventory Item per Variant within a Site.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Inventory Level
schemas.purpose: Provides quantities from which availability is derived.

validationRules.description: One active level per Inventory Item and Location.
available is derived and not independently edited.
Stored level quantities are non-negative.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Inventory Location
schemas.purpose: Supports multi-location inventory without coupling to hosting/server regions.

fields.description: Whether stock may be held here.
Whether this location fulfills online orders.

validationRules.description: Inventory Location is never a hosting/server region.
Location code is unique within Site.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Inventory Reservation
schemas.purpose: Distinguishes allocated stock from on-hand stock to support oversell prevention.

validationRules.description: Reserved quantity must be greater than zero.
Reservation always identifies its source.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Inventory Transfer
schemas.purpose: Prevents multi-location stock movement from being represented as unexplained quantity edits.

validationRules.description: Source and destination must be different.
receivedAt cannot precede sentAt.
Transfer completion must result in traceable inventory adjustments rather than silent balance mutation.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Inventory Transfer Line
schemas.purpose: Preserves quantity movement between inventory locations.

validationRules.description: Transfer quantity must be greater than zero.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Money Snapshot
schemas.purpose: Prevents transaction values from depending on mutable Site defaults.

validationRules.description: Every monetary snapshot includes currency.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Order
schemas.purpose: Separates financial, fulfillment and operational state while preserving committed snapshots.

validationRules.description: Payment, fulfillment and overall Order states are separate dimensions.
Order number is unique within Site.
Catalog/customer changes do not mutate committed Order snapshots.
Financial state is reconciled through Payment/Refund records, not arbitrary direct edits.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Order Address Snapshot
schemas.purpose: Preserves fulfillment/billing history when saved addresses later change.

validationRules.description: Committed Order address snapshots do not follow later profile edits.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Order Line
schemas.purpose: Ensures historical orders do not change when Product title, SKU or price changes later.

fields.description: Discount allocations applied to this line.

validationRules.description: Committed Order Line commercial values are immutable.
Purchased quantity is greater than zero.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Order Source
schemas.purpose: Records transaction origin without embedding provider-specific campaign models.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Order Totals
schemas.purpose: Preserves historical totals independently from mutable catalog, shipping, tax and promotion settings.

validationRules.description: All totals share one currency.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Fulfillment Package
schemas.description: Physical package information for a shipment.
schemas.purpose: Supports multi-package fulfillment without mixing package measurements into product catalog definitions.

fields.description: Package weight in configured store unit.

validationRules.description: Package measurements cannot be negative.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Payment
schemas.purpose: Separates NEXT F Payment semantics from provider-specific transaction APIs.

validationRules.description: Payment never stores PAN/CVV.
Provider payloads are translated through adapters.
Payment currency must be valid for its Order.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Payment Attempt
schemas.purpose: Preserves retries/failures without logging protected provider credentials.

validationRules.description: Failure details cannot include secrets or raw provider payloads.
Attempts are historical records.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Payment Authorization
schemas.purpose: Separates authorization from capture so payment state is not reduced to a single ambiguous flag.

validationRules.description: Provider references must not contain raw card credentials.
Authorization amount must be consistent with the owning Payment's permitted amount.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Payment Capture
schemas.purpose: Records actual capture separately from authorization and later refunds.

validationRules.description: Aggregate successful captures cannot silently exceed the Payment's authorized/permitted amount.
Successful capture facts are append-only; reversals/refunds require separate records.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Payment Method Reference
schemas.purpose: Supports operational display/reference without raw card credentials.

validationRules.description: Full card PAN is prohibited.
CVV/CVC is prohibited.
Provider reference is opaque and non-public.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Product
schemas.purpose: Defines Product content while transaction state remains in Cart, Checkout and Order contracts.

validationRules.description: Published Product slug is unique within Site/locale.
Catalog price changes never rewrite historical Orders.
Subscription, booking and other specialized types require explicit implemented capability contracts.

delivery.notes: Only explicitly public storefront fields may be delivered; operational, personal, payment and internal metadata remain private.

schemas.name: Product Attribute Definition
schemas.purpose: Separates Product characteristics from variant-generating options.

fields.description: Whether storefront filters may use it.
Whether storefront search may index it.

validationRules.description: Attribute key is unique within the Site.
Select types require allowed options.

delivery.notes: Only explicitly public storefront fields may be delivered; operational, personal, payment and internal metadata remain private.

schemas.name: Product Attribute Value
schemas.purpose: Carries one Product's value while retaining canonical attribute semantics.

validationRules.description: Value must match the referenced attribute definition.

delivery.notes: Only explicitly public storefront fields may be delivered; operational, personal, payment and internal metadata remain private.

schemas.name: Product Availability
schemas.purpose: Lets storefronts display availability without exposing operational inventory details.

validationRules.description: Availability does not replace Inventory Level.

delivery.notes: Only explicitly public storefront fields may be delivered; operational, personal, payment and internal metadata remain private.

schemas.name: Product Category
schemas.purpose: Provides stable Product categorization distinct from campaign collections.

validationRules.description: Category hierarchy cannot contain cycles.
Published category slugs are unique within Site/locale.

delivery.notes: Only explicitly public storefront fields may be delivered; operational, personal, payment and internal metadata remain private.

schemas.name: Product Collection
schemas.purpose: Separates campaign merchandising groups from Product taxonomy.

validationRules.description: Manual collections use Product IDs; automatic collections use rules.
Published collection slugs are unique within Site/locale.

delivery.notes: Only explicitly public storefront fields may be delivered; operational, personal, payment and internal metadata remain private.

schemas.name: Product Option
schemas.description: Variant-generating option such as Size or Color.
schemas.purpose: Defines option dimensions used to construct Product Variants.

validationRules.description: Option value keys are unique within the option.

delivery.notes: Only explicitly public storefront fields may be delivered; operational, personal, payment and internal metadata remain private.

schemas.name: Product Option Value
schemas.description: Selectable value within a Product Option.
schemas.purpose: Standardizes values such as Small, Black or 256 GB.

delivery.notes: Only explicitly public storefront fields may be delivered; operational, personal, payment and internal metadata remain private.

schemas.name: Product Price
schemas.description: Mutable catalog price for a Product or Variant.
schemas.purpose: Separates current catalog price from committed transaction snapshots.

validationRules.description: Catalog prices cannot be negative.
Compare-at prices cannot be fabricated to create misleading savings.
Internal cost must never be delivered publicly.

delivery.notes: Only explicitly public storefront fields may be delivered; operational, personal, payment and internal metadata remain private.

schemas.name: Product Review
schemas.purpose: Supports moderated reviews with explicit verified-purchase truthfulness rules.

validationRules.description: verifiedPurchase is system-derived from qualifying Order data and cannot be manually fabricated.
Only approved reviews may be eligible for public display.
Structured review data may use only truthful qualifying approved review records.

delivery.notes: Only explicitly public storefront fields may be delivered; operational, personal, payment and internal metadata remain private.

schemas.name: Product Variant
schemas.purpose: Provides SKU, option combination, price and fulfillment/inventory settings at purchasable-unit level.

validationRules.description: Option combination is unique within the Product.
SKU is unique within Site when present.
weight and weightUnit appear together.

delivery.notes: Only explicitly public storefront fields may be delivered; operational, personal, payment and internal metadata remain private.

schemas.name: Promotion Benefit
schemas.description: Economic benefit granted by a Promotion.
schemas.purpose: Keeps discount outcome separate from eligibility conditions.

validationRules.description: Required value/currency fields depend on benefit type.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Promotion Condition
schemas.purpose: Supports merchant promotions without arbitrary executable expressions.

validationRules.description: Only registered condition/operator combinations may execute.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Quantity
schemas.purpose: Supports whole-unit and measured products.

validationRules.description: Generic quantities are non-negative.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Refund
schemas.purpose: Records financial reversal without rewriting historical Order prices.

validationRules.description: Refund amount is greater than zero.
Refunds never rewrite Order Line price snapshots.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Refund Line
schemas.purpose: Preserves which purchased quantities and amounts were financially refunded.

fields.description: Refund amount assigned to the line.

validationRules.description: Refunded quantity cannot exceed refundable purchased quantity.
Line refund amount cannot exceed the refundable line amount.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Return Line
schemas.description: One purchased line requested for return.
schemas.purpose: Standardizes Return quantity and reason against an Order Line.

validationRules.description: Return quantity is greater than zero.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Return Request
schemas.purpose: Models merchandise return separately from financial Refund processing.

validationRules.description: Cumulative return quantity cannot exceed eligible purchased quantity.
Refund resolutions create/use canonical Refund records rather than rewriting Payment state.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Return Resolution
schemas.purpose: Keeps physical/logistical return handling distinct from financial refund records.

fields.description: Related Refund ID when money was returned.

validationRules.description: A refund resolution references a canonical Refund rather than embedding a second financial ledger.
Resolved outcomes must preserve the actor and time when available.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Review Moderation
schemas.purpose: Separates submitted review content from moderation decisions.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Sales Channel
schemas.purpose: Lets orders and catalog publication use a provider-neutral channel identity.

validationRules.description: Channel key is unique within a Site.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Shipment
schemas.purpose: Separates carrier tracking from Order fulfillment allocation.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Shipping Method
schemas.purpose: Separates shipping configuration from Fulfillment and Shipment execution.

validationRules.description: Delivery estimates are not guarantees unless separately committed.

delivery.notes: Only explicitly public storefront fields may be delivered; operational, personal, payment and internal metadata remain private.

schemas.name: Shipping Rate
schemas.purpose: Supports common pricing strategies while provider rating stays in Integration adapters.

validationRules.description: Required amount/range fields depend on pricingType.
External rating requires a supported Integration.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Shipping Zone
schemas.purpose: Allows shipping methods/rates without hardcoded site logic.

validationRules.description: Active zone defines at least one geography rule.
Postal matching cannot execute arbitrary regex/code.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Store Settings
schemas.description: Site-level operational defaults for a commerce-enabled Site.
schemas.purpose: Provides provider-neutral store configuration without hosting/domain/payment-provider coupling.

validationRules.description: Store settings do not model hosting or domain subscriptions.
Store currency is always explicit.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Tax Class
schemas.purpose: Keeps product tax classification provider-neutral and separate from tax-rate configuration.

fields.description: Whether the tax class may be assigned.

validationRules.description: A published tax-class key must not be repurposed with different semantics.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Tax Configuration
schemas.purpose: Separates merchant configuration from calculated Tax Lines and provider integrations.

fields.description: Whether catalog prices include tax by default.

validationRules.description: NEXT F configuration does not determine merchant tax obligations.
External calculation requires a supported Integration adapter.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Tax Line
schemas.purpose: Preserves tax applied at transaction time despite later Tax Rate changes.

validationRules.description: Committed Tax Lines do not follow later Tax Rate edits.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Tax Rate
schemas.purpose: Provides simple provider-neutral tax-rate structure while complex tax engines remain external adapters.

validationRules.description: validUntil must be after validFrom.
The contract does not determine legal tax obligations.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.

schemas.name: Tracking Reference
schemas.purpose: Makes carrier tracking provider-neutral.

validationRules.description: Carrier-specific statuses are mapped to canonical values.

delivery.notes: Private or operational commerce data; not eligible for unauthenticated public delivery.
